newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips slump; long-term interest rates rise to 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips slump; long-term interest rates rise to 7 pct.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks slumped Monday in the second-slowest session of the year as a jump in long-term interest rates to the 7 percent level drew Wall Street's attention from a battery of merger deals.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 28.85 points at 5,693.89. In the broader market, declining issues beat advances 13-8. Volume of 283 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange was the year's second-smallest, after 281.3 million shares traded on July 29.
